title: Final Intensity Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the intensity I(theta) in terms of a, b, c, and theta.

title: Special Case (a=b)
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly simplify the intensity expression for the case when a equals b.

title: Special Case (a=0)
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly derive the intensity expression for the case when a equals 0.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly define and use the variables u and v in the derivation.

title: Clear Sketches
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide clear sketches of the diffraction patterns for the special cases.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors in the cosine term of the intensity expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.
